svg.title: Custom SGEMM: matrix multiplication drawn as a room, A on the left wall, B on the back wall, C on the floor; tile by tile, a strip of A and a strip of B light up and a tile of C fills. 169.6 to 1,052.9 GFLOPS on an RTX 4060, 6.5 times faster.
